limitations: List POST JSON /incrementProductsPage.json sends only tenant GUAPW3SG, rowStart 0 and qualified pageSize 5000; native total completeness is required. Width is not a demonstrated maximum.
List retains all native fields, nested arrays/objects, nulls, precise values, returned versions and arrival order. No latest reducer, upstream filters or extra terminal query.
Currency, bank and status are exact local repeatable filters, usable offline. Bare offline List replays its saved acquisition.

Get first sends POST form /incrementProductDetail.json with tenant and physical incrementProductId, then POST form /incrementProductHistoryQuery.json with tenant and that detail's incrementProductCode. It returns {detail, history}, retaining both native roots and validating historical lineage.

Get and selected-window live --with-detail use the Custom SDK, share at most 10000 requests and 300 seconds, and never publish cache or Duckdog data. Any required inquiry failure aborts the entire query; rate-source groups remain outside this leaf.
List/detail preserve missing, null and empty-string tenants. History also preserves whitespace-only tenant strings. Every returned nonblank tenant must match GUAPW3SG.

History completion covers the qualified native response array, including empty arrays, with unknown backend total. No current-row append, latest-version selection, source sorting or proof of invisible backend versions.
Detail and history are sequential independent reads, without an atomic snapshot guarantee or cross-source same-ID value equality. Coverage and component evidence remain in query_evidence.
